# Task: website copy

Write the copy for the [page and section] of doefin.com, following the v3 structure.

- What the reader should understand: [one sentence]
- What they should do next: [the one button]
- Facts and figures, with sources: [list]

Shape: a heading under eight words that says what the reader gets or does ("Put your hashrate view to work."); one sentence for each reader it serves (miners hedge, investors trade a view); the limit or risk line next to any claim; one primary button that starts with a verb ("Enter app"); at most two text links. Say how a market works only once on the site. Any made-up or sample figure carries the Illustrative badge. Pages end with the footer in Matteo's words.

Give me the heading, body, button and links, then anything Matteo must review.
